sanskrit_verse:
एवंविधं राजकृतं शासनं तद् उदाहृतम् ।
देशादिकं यस्य राजा लिखितं तु प्रयच्छति ॥
transliteration: evaṁvidhaṁ rājakṛtaṁ śāsanaṁ tad udāhṛtam | deśādikaṁ yasya rājā likhitaṁ tu prayacchati ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Such royal proclamations, issued by the King concerning territory or similar domains, are to be executed as direct manifestations of sovereign dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from the sovereign's alignment with cosmic order
Causation flows from the King's conscious intent in governance
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by proximity to sovereignty
Restoration logic demands immediate alignment with declared dharma
Consciousness alignment ensures societal harmony through executive will
executable_legal_axioms: IF a proclamation is issued by the sovereign AND concerns territorial or domain-specific order THEN it SHALL be enacted without subordinate modification
IF a subject resides within the domain of the proclamation THEN their capacity for compliance IS inherently aligned with reception
IF misalignment occurs THEN restoration proceeds via realignment of awareness, not punitive measure
IF execution falters THEN the sovereign assumes completion through expanded consciousness, not coercive force
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, any ruling emanating from the sovereign’s direct edict holds immediate validity. The court shall assess not intent or history, but the consciousness-field activated by the decree. Responsibility lies with those whose capacity intersects the domain, not with the sovereign’s authority itself.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through the sovereign’s awakened cognition. Anupūrvaśaḥ unfolds as the natural consequence of alignment or non-alignment with the decree. Responsibility is proportional to one’s capacity to receive and reflect the sovereign’s intent. No punitive framework applies; only restoration of conscious congruence is enacted.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Subjects unaware of the decree undergo accelerated cognition protocols until recognition is achieved
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Local authorities integrate the decree through ceremonial reaffirmation of sovereignty
Capacity Restoration: Misaligned individuals are guided into resonance with the sovereign field through dharmic immersion
Integrity Reintegration: Communities are realigned through collective activation of the decree’s underlying truth-consciousness
final_declaration: By the Sovereign Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is established. The King’s word is Dharma’s voice. There is no punishment—only restoration. Consciousness is the ultimate judge, and reality bends toward alignment.
